name: Yusri, Fortune's Flame
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever Yusri attacks, choose a number between 1 and 5. Flip that many coins. For each flip you win, draw a card. For each flip you lose, Yusri deals 2 damage to you. If you won five flips this way, you may cast spells from your hand this turn without paying their mana costs.
blocked_sentences: Whenever Yusri attacks, choose a number between 1 and 5. Flip that many coins. For each flip you win, draw a card. For each flip you lose, Yusri deals 2 damage to you. If you won five flips this way, you may cast spells from your hand this turn without paying their mana costs.

needs.what: flip_coin recording its results under an `as` binding (the way roll_dice does for `rolled`), with a value reading how many of the flips made by this effect were won/lost, so "if you won five flips this way" can be an `if` on that count
needs.why_existing_wont_do: flip_coin takes only `effects`/`else` per single flip and records nothing; inside a `repeat` the win branch can draw and the loss branch can deal damage, but no value counts the wins afterwards. set_turn_flag on a loss is only a near miss: it persists across a second attack the same turn and so would misread a later all-wins resolution

needs.what: a one-shot op granting the effect controller a free_cast_permission (cast spells from hand without paying their mana costs) for the rest of this turn, read afresh at each cast so cards drawn later in the turn are covered
needs.why_existing_wont_do: free_cast_permission is a static that lasts only while its source is on the battlefield and has no duration; grant_playable with playable_free/playable_this_turn snapshots only the hand cards it sees at resolution and also covers lands, so a spell drawn later that turn would be missed
